project.name: WZTrack Platform
project.description: Full lifecycle project tracking platform covering issue management, requirements, QA, test cases and traceability.

requirements.title: User authentication and role-based access control
requirements.description: The platform must authenticate all users with email and password credentials using RS256 JWT tokens. Access to features must be gated by user role: admin, manager, developer, and viewer.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
- Admin can access all features.
- Viewer role is read-only.
- Expired tokens are rejected with 401.
- Passwords are stored as bcrypt hashes.

requirements.title: Project creation and membership management
requirements.description: Users with admin or manager role must be able to create projects, assign a unique project key, and add or remove members with specific roles.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
- Project key must be unique and uppercase alphanumeric.
- Admin sees all projects. Non-admin sees only member projects.
- Member roles: owner, manager, developer, viewer.

requirements.title: Issue board with configurable workflow states
requirements.description: Each project must have a Kanban-style board where issues can be moved through configurable workflow states grouped by category: unstarted, started, done, cancelled.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
- States are per-project and configurable.
- Issues can be filtered by assignee, priority, type, and sprint.
- Board reflects real-time state changes.

requirements.title: Requirements management with version history
requirements.description: The platform must allow business analysts to capture, version, and approve requirements. Each change must produce a new version record without losing prior versions.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
- Requirements have unique IDs (prefix-NNN format).
- Every update increments version number.
- Status flow: draft -> in-review -> approved -> deprecated.
- Approved requirements can be linked to issues for traceability.

requirements.title: Test case management and QA gate enforcement
requirements.description: Developers and QA engineers must be able to create test plans, write test cases linked to requirements, and record test runs. A QA gate must block issues from moving to Done without a passing test run.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
- Test cases link to requirements via traceability matrix.
- Test run statuses: pass, fail, blocked, skipped.
- Issue cannot be set to a Done state without at least one passing test run linked.

requirements.title: Per-project wiki for living documentation
requirements.description: Each project must provide a rich wiki where team members can maintain living documentation including architecture decisions, runbooks, and onboarding guides.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
- Pages support Markdown content.
- Page slugs are auto-generated from titles.
- All changes are versioned.
- Pages are scoped per project.

requirements.title: File attachment support on issues
requirements.description: Users must be able to attach files (screenshots, logs, specs) to issues. The platform must enforce a max file size and store attachments securely on the server.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
- Max issue attachment: 10 MB.
- Supported MIME types: image/*, application/pdf, text/*.
- Attachments are accessible via authenticated download URL.

requirements.title: Traceability matrix and coverage reporting
requirements.description: The platform must provide a traceability view that maps requirements to linked issues and test cases, allowing stakeholders to assess coverage and progress at a glance.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
- Matrix shows requirement -> issue -> test case linkage.
- Coverage percentage shown per requirement.
- Exportable to CSV.

wiki.title: Project overview
wiki.content:
# WZTrack Platform

## What is WZTrack?

WZTrack is a full lifecycle project tracking platform built for software teams. It covers issue management, requirements engineering, test case management, QA gates, traceability, and a project wiki.

## Goals

- Provide a single source of truth for requirements, work items, and quality evidence.
- Enforce a traceable path from business requirement to tested, deployed feature.
- Keep documentation close to the work with a per-project wiki.

## Stakeholders

| Role | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| Product Owner | Approves requirements and priorities |
| BA Lead | Writes and maintains requirements |
| Tech Lead | Owns architecture decisions |
| QA Lead | Owns test plans and QA gate policy |

wiki.title: Architecture decision record technology stack
wiki.content:
# ADR-001: Technology stack selection

**Date:** 2026-04-09  **Status:** Accepted

## Context

The team needed a modern, maintainable stack for WZTrack that supports async operations, strong type safety, and a clean API-first architecture.

## Decision

| Layer | Technology | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| API | FastAPI + Python 3.12 | Async-native, auto OpenAPI docs, type safety via Pydantic |
| Database | PostgreSQL 16 | JSONB support, mature async driver (asyncpg) |
| ORM | SQLAlchemy 2 async | Type-safe mapped columns, Alembic migration support |
| Auth | RS256 JWT | Stateless, supports key rotation |
| Frontend | React 18 + TypeScript | Component model, strong ecosystem |
| UI | Ant Design 5 | Comprehensive, accessible component set |
| Containers | Docker Compose | Portable, reproducible dev environment |

## Consequences

- All API responses are schema-validated by Pydantic.
- Frontend calls the API exclusively via `/api/v1`.
- Migrations managed with Alembic before any production deployment.

wiki.title: Development setup guide
wiki.content:
# Development setup guide

## Before you begin

- Docker Desktop or Rancher Desktop installed and running
- Git configured with your credentials
- Ports 8080 and 8000 available on your machine

## Steps

1. Clone the repository.
2. Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and fill in required values.
3. Run `docker compose up --build` from the `wztrack/` directory.
4. Access the app at `http://localhost:8080`.
5. Log in with `admin@wztrack.io` / `admin1234`.
6. Change the admin password immediately after first login.

## Port reference

| Service | Host port |
|---|---|
| Frontend (nginx) | 8080 |
| API (uvicorn) | 8000 |
| PostgreSQL | not exposed |

## Troubleshooting

- **Docker context wrong:** run `docker context use default`.
- **Port 80 conflict on Windows:** Rancher Desktop owns port 80 via host-switch. Use 8080.
- **bcrypt error on startup:** ensure `bcrypt==3.2.2` is pinned in `requirements.txt`.
- **JWT PEM error:** the `.env` must store newlines as `\n`. Check `jwt_private_key_pem` property in `config.py`.

wiki.title: QA gate policy
wiki.content:
# QA gate policy

## Purpose

This policy defines the quality gate that all issues must pass before they can move to a Done workflow state.

## Gate rule

An issue cannot transition to any workflow state with category `done` unless it has at least one linked test run with status `pass`.

## Workflow

1. Developer creates an issue and writes code.
2. QA engineer creates a test case and links it to the issue.
3. QA engineer records a test run against the test case.
4. If the run passes, the issue can move to Done.
5. If no passing run exists, the API returns HTTP 422 with code `QA_GATE_BLOCKED`.

## Exceptions

Exceptions require QA Lead approval, documented as a comment on the issue before any manual DB state change.

issues.title: Implement RS256 JWT auth endpoints

issues.title: Implement user registration

issues.title: Project CRUD API
issues.description: GET /projects, POST /projects, GET /projects/{id}, PATCH /projects/{id}, DELETE /projects/{id}.

issues.title: Configurable workflow states per project
issues.description: POST /projects/{id}/states - each project defines its own Kanban columns with category mapping.

issues.title: Issue CRUD with auto sequence numbers
issues.description: Issues get auto-incremented sequence numbers per project (WZT-1, WZT-2). Supports type, priority, assignee, sprint, story points.

issues.title: Requirements CRUD with version history
issues.description: Every requirement update creates a RequirementVersion record. req_id auto-generated as {KEY}-R{N}.

issues.title: Wiki pages CRUD with versioning
issues.description: Markdown wiki pages per project. Auto-slug from title. All edits versioned.

issues.title: Test plan and test case management API
issues.description: Test plans scoped to project. Test cases linked to requirements. Supports manual and automated case types.

issues.title: Test run recording and QA gate enforcement
issues.description: Record pass/fail/blocked/skipped runs against test cases. Block Done transition without passing run.

issues.title: Traceability matrix API
issues.description: GET /traceability/project/{id} - returns requirement to issue to test case linkage map with coverage stats.

issues.title: File attachment upload on issues
issues.description: Multipart upload endpoint. Max 10 MB. Stored in /uploads volume. Authenticated download URL.

issues.title: Frontend: login page
issues.description: Ant Design login form. Posts to /api/v1/auth/login. Stores JWT in Zustand. Redirects to dashboard.

issues.title: Frontend: project list and creation
issues.description: List user projects. Create project modal with key and name validation.

issues.title: Frontend: Kanban board
issues.description: Drag-and-drop Kanban board grouped by workflow state. Swimlane by assignee option.

issues.title: Frontend: requirements list and editor
issues.description: Table view of requirements with status badges. Inline editor for description and acceptance criteria.

issues.title: Frontend: wiki reader and editor
issues.description: Render Markdown wiki pages. Inline edit mode with preview. Page tree navigation.

issues.title: Pin bcrypt==3.2.2 to fix passlib compatibility
issues.description: passlib 1.7.4 + bcrypt 4.x incompatible. Bcrypt 4 rejects 73-byte wrap-bug detection password. Pin to 3.2.2.

issues.title: Fix FastAPI 204 route return annotation issue
issues.description: FastAPI treats -> None on 204 routes as NoneType response model triggering assertion. Remove return annotations.

issues.title: Fix JWT PEM key double-escape in .env
issues.description: pydantic-settings reads \n from .env as literal backslash+n. jwt_private_key_pem must replace double \\n.

issues.title: Switch frontend port from 80 to 8080
issues.description: Rancher Desktop host-switch process owns port 80 on Windows. Map nginx to 8080:80.

issues.title: Change admin seed email TLD from .local to .io
issues.description: email-validator rejects .local as reserved TLD. Changed to admin@wztrack.io.

issues.title: Set up Alembic migrations
issues.description: Replace create_all on startup with proper Alembic migration chain before any production deployment.

issues.title: Add token blocklist for logout invalidation
issues.description: Current logout is stateless. Add Redis-backed blocklist so revoked tokens are rejected before expiry.

issues.title: Write Pytest integration test suite
issues.description: Cover auth, project CRUD, issue CRUD, QA gate, and traceability endpoints with async test client.
